english.note: This is the all-purpose colloquial verb for kissing, including when the context makes it clear that two people are kissing each other.

examples.english: When I see you, I can't help wanting to kiss you.
examples.traditional: 見到你，我就忍唔住想錫你一啖。
examples.jyutping: gin3 dou2 nei5 ngo5 zau6 jan2 m4 zyu6 soeng2 sek3 nei5 jat1 daam6

english.note: Use this as the everyday all-purpose choice for lovingly pampering someone, without necessarily implying that they are spoiled.

examples.english: I always cosset my daughter, arranging everything for her.
examples.traditional: 我成日錫住個女，乜都幫佢安排好。
examples.jyutping: ngo5 seng4 jat6 sek3 zyu6 go3 neoi2 mat1 dou1 bong1 keoi5 on1 paai4 hou2
